name: Dawn Regalia (Draknisa signature)
description: an ornate floor-length dawn gown of {{PRIMARY}} and deep-teal silk with a fitted bodice embroidered with {{METAL}} pearls and shell motifs, a high collar of layered scallop-shell plates, long sleeves of sheer sea-foam gauze, and a skirt of flowing ribbons that ripples like water around her; sweetheart neckline
notes: Worn in the Dawn scene: a highly decorative, flowing gown built to move while rising from the Sundering.
